svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The deep part of a stock IP67 box, 115 x 65 mm outside, 40 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: deep from the rim, 2.5 mm wall, four corner screw towers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 4.5 mm holes in the floor at 40 and 18 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the centre lines. Easiest: stand the base on the bracket plate,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre it, and mark through the stud positions.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the floor, pilot drill 2.5 mm slowly with wood behind, then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4.5 mm. Deburr inside and out; no solvents on ABS or PC.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the outside of the floor sits flat on the plate; the studs pass

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through, and a sealing washer and a standoff go on each one inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the base sits flat on the plate with all four studs through
